solutions.title: DFS with visited matrix
solutions.strategy: When unvisited land is found, count an island and DFS through all connected land while marking a visited matrix.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each grid cell is inspected, and each land cell is visited by DFS once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The visited matrix and worst-case recursion stack can both scale with the number of cells.

solutions.title: In-place island sinking
solutions.strategy: Mutate discovered land cells to water while DFS explores each island.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every cell is scanned and each land cell is converted once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: No visited matrix is needed, but the DFS call stack can still contain many cells in a large island.
